name: AI Drawer
description: Slide-out AI agent panel opened via Tools > AI or the notch button. Implements a full agentic loop: sends user messages to an OpenAI-compatible LLM, executes tool calls against the __cockpit canvas bridge and electronAPI, and renders results as Markdown. Supports three agent modes (AUTO / PLAN / STEP), abort, prompt queuing, mid-run steering, and persistent per-workspace session storage in {workspace}/.cockpit/ai-sessions.json.

dependencies.usage: Reads window.__cockpit for canvas operations: getCanvasState, panToCard, setView, zoomIn, zoomOut, openFile, addPlugin, focusCard, closeCard, moveCard, resizeCard, autoArrange, writeToTerminal, readTerminal, insertInEditor, readEditor, getEditorState, setEditorContent, goToLine, getWorkspacePath, reopenCard, resetView, refreshSpecsMap, regenerateSpecs

referenced_by.usage: Instantiated in App constructor; toggle() called from TopBar AI button; resetSessions() called on workspace load

ipc.usage: Loads ai-sessions.json on first drawer open
Creates .cockpit/ dir before first session write (once per workspace)
Loads aiApiKey, aiModel, aiEndpoint settings on first message send
Saves apiKey, model, endpoint when user clicks Save in settings panel

state.messages: ChatMessage[] — in-memory conversation history for current session
state.sessions: Session[] — all sessions for current workspace
state.sessionsLoaded: boolean — guard to ensure loadSessions() runs once per workspace
state.cockpitDirEnsured: boolean — guard to avoid redundant fs.mkdir IPC calls
state.isLoading: boolean — true while agentic loop is running
state.abortRequested: boolean — set by abort button to stop the loop
state.fetchController: AbortController | null — cancels in-flight fetch on abort
state.continueResolve: (() => void) | null — Promise resolver for STEP mode pause
state.promptQueue: string[] — messages queued while agent is running
state.steeringMessage: string | null — next steering injection, set via steer button

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Builds drawer DOM (header with mode bar + sessions/settings buttons, message area, step controls, queue bar, input area with send/abort/steer buttons, settings panel, sessions panel), mounts notch button outside drawer, binds all event listeners, shows welcome message, loads API settings.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Opens or closes the drawer. On open, awaits loadSessions() before showing UI to prevent stale state flash. On close, hides settings and sessions panels.

methods.name: resetSessions
methods.description: Clears all session state (sessions, currentSessionId, sessionsLoaded, cockpitDirEnsured, promptQueue, steeringMessage) and shows welcome message. Called by App.loadWorkspace() on workspace change.

agent_modes.auto: Default — agentic loop runs until model returns a non-tool-call response or abort.
agent_modes.plan: Two-phase: first LLM call generates a numbered plan (no tools allowed); user approves or stops; second call uses tool_choice:'required' to force tool execution on the approved plan.
agent_modes.step: Pauses before each tool batch via waitForAction() Promise; user can Continue (resume) or Stop (abort). Step controls shown between body and input while paused.
